'''Galactic Moon Coins''' were tokens given to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] by celebrants of the [[Galactic Moon Festival]]. If the celebrants were impressed or scared of a spacers costume, they would give them these coins. The coins could be given to [[Z'ozpheratu]] in exchange for a number of prizes. These coins had the face of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] imprinted on both sides.<ref name="SWG:GMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Galactic Moon Festival}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Galactic Moon Coins were tokens awarded to players in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', who participated in the Galactic Moon Festival event. By collecting this tokens, they could turn them into Z'ozpheratu, who was actually a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC), for various items.<ref name="SWG:GMF" />
